description: Lets an agent search a knowledge graph built by KnowledgeGraphBuilderComponent via search_entities/get_entity/get_neighbors/find_path/top_entities.

outputs.description: Registers a resource + (optionally) an MCP server resource, plus a small inspection asset.

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Dagster resource key the in-process KnowledgeGraphSearchResource is registered under.

mcp_server_resource_key.label: Mcp Server Resource Key
mcp_server_resource_key.description: If set, ALSO registers a stdio MCP-server-shaped resource under this key, built from this component's own settings. Any mcp_servers-aware component can then reference it via server_resource_key.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: Graph store the knowledge graph lives in.

path.label: Path
path.description: networkx only: local JSON file path (written by KnowledgeGraphBuilderComponent's write_graph step).

username_env_var.label: Username Env Var
username_env_var.description: neo4j/falkordb: env var holding the username.

password_env_var.label: Password Env Var
password_env_var.description: neo4j/falkordb: env var holding the password.

graph_name.label: Graph Name
graph_name.description: neo4j/falkordb: the `graph` tag / FalkorDB graph key the builder wrote under. networkx: only used to name the default file path when `path` is unset.

inspection_asset_name.label: Inspection Asset Name
inspection_asset_name.description: Asset key for the inspection asset reporting this server's configured settings.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Extra asset tags, applied to the inspection asset.

sql_dialect.label: Sql Dialect
sql_dialect.description: sql_tables only: 'snowflake_cortex', 'bigquery', or 'databricks' -- same 3 dialects as knowledge_graph_builder's own execution_mode='sql'.

output_table.label: Output Table
output_table.description: sql_tables only: the base table name knowledge_graph_builder's write_graph step wrote under (reads <output_table>_nodes/<output_table>_edges).

snowflake_account_env_var.label: Snowflake Account Env Var
snowflake_account_env_var.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='snowflake_cortex': env var holding the Snowflake account identifier.

snowflake_user_env_var.label: Snowflake User Env Var
snowflake_user_env_var.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='snowflake_cortex': env var holding the Snowflake username.

snowflake_password_env_var.label: Snowflake Password Env Var
snowflake_password_env_var.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='snowflake_cortex': env var holding the Snowflake password.

snowflake_warehouse.label: Snowflake Warehouse
snowflake_warehouse.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='snowflake_cortex': virtual warehouse. Uses the user default if unset.

databricks_host_env_var.label: Databricks Host Env Var
databricks_host_env_var.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='databricks': env var holding the workspace URL.

databricks_token_env_var.label: Databricks Token Env Var
databricks_token_env_var.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='databricks': env var holding a personal access token.

databricks_http_path.label: Databricks Http Path
databricks_http_path.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='databricks': SQL warehouse HTTP path, e.g. /sql/1.0/warehouses/<id>.

bigquery_project_id.label: Bigquery Project Id
bigquery_project_id.description: sql_tables + sql_dialect='bigquery': GCP project for the BQ job. Defaults to the ambient credentials' project.
